research_notes: Entity: PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk (unchanged legal name), 85.0% owned by Unilever Indonesia Holding B.V.; ultimate parent Unilever PLC (FS2025 Note 1/19). The audited FS are the company's OWN financial statements ('Laporan Keuangan', not 'Konsolidasian'): UNVR has no subsidiaries and no non-controlling interests in FY2019-H1 2026. The figures therefore cover the whole reporting entity and are stored with basis 'consolidated' (nothing to consolidate, no parent-only/consolidated mix); equity_attr = total_equity and net_profit_attr = profit for the year. Reviewer: confirm this use of 'consolidated'.

Currency/units: IDR reporter; money in IDR billion (Rp juta / 1,000). Each FY is taken from that year's own audited FS (FS2019 ... FS2025, KPMG Siddharta Widjaja & Rekan); balance-sheet comparatives in later FS agree with the originals (checked FS2020 vs FS2019, FS2021-FS2025 comparatives).

Discontinued operations: the ice cream business was sold to PT The Magnum Ice Cream Indonesia for Rp7.0 tn ex-VAT (EGMS + independent GMS 14 Jan 2025; transferred 8 Dec 2025) and the SariWangi tea business to PT Savoria Kreasi Rasa for Rp1.5 tn (announced 7 Jan 2026, completed 2 Mar 2026). FS2025 presents both as discontinued operations, so FY2025 revenue, gross profit, operating profit and EBITDA are CONTINUING operations only, while FY2020-FY2024 are as originally reported (incl. ice cream and tea). The 2024->2025 revenue drop (35,138.6 -> 31,943.5 bn) is mostly this presentation change: FS2025 re-presents FY2024 continuing sales as 30,622.6 bn (+4.3% in 2025) and total-operations FY2025 sales were 36.4 tn (deck PDF p. 8, +3.5%). FY2025 net profit (7,641.2 bn) includes the after-tax ice cream gain of 3,794.4 bn; continuing-operations profit was 3,537.3 bn (EPS 93). H1 2026 profit includes the SariWangi gain of 870.3 bn.

EBITDA is printed on the face of every audited P&L with a reconciliation note (Note 35/36/35): profit + income tax + net finance costs + depreciation of fixed assets and right-of-use assets + amortisation. FY2025 and the H1 figures are continuing operations only.

Debt: UNVR's only interest-bearing borrowings are short-term unsecured bank loans for working capital (Note 13; e.g. FY2024 HSBC 900 bn + MUFG 550 bn); it has never issued bonds, MTN or sukuk (AR2024 PDF p. 19). Lease liabilities (PSAK 73, adopted with a restated 2018 in FS2019) are excluded and listed in each total_debt note. Year-end bank borrowings were nil at 31 Dec 2023, 31 Dec 2025 and 30 Jun 2026.

Payout: UNVR distributes ~100% of profit every year (interim in Nov/Dec + final after the June AGMS). FY2023 payout was 111.2% (final paid partly from retained earnings). FY2025 total Rp201/share = 100% of a profit that includes the ice cream gain. Low equity and >100% payouts make reported ROE very high (121.8%-140.2% in 2020-2024, on AVERAGE equity) - real, not a unit slip.

Share buyback: 31 Jul - 30 Oct 2025, up to Rp2 tn (FS2025 Note 19, PDF p. 66); 168,766,700 shares repurchased for Rp285.045 bn and held as treasury shares (FS2025 Note 19). shares_out FY2025 and H1 2026 are net of them (37,981,233,300); FY2025 weighted average 38,087 million.

Stock split 1:5 effective 2 Jan 2020 (corporate_actions). All per-share values stored (FY2020 onward, dividends, AR prices) are on the post-split basis and their share_basis dates are after the split. The AR 10-year price charts show the 2019 close split-adjusted as Rp8,400 (AR2021 PDF p. 15); not stored (no rights/bonus issue before 2020-12-31).

Dividend schedules come from the KSEI notices (web.ksei.co.id, fetched directly) that relay the company's notifications; totals from the FS dividend notes and the AGMS press releases. Two schedules were revised by KSEI: FY2022 final (KSEI-13867/JKU/0623 moved recording 5 -> 7 Jul 2023; stored) and FY2023 interim (KSEI-24880/JKU/1123 moved recording 8 -> 6 Dec 2023; stored, although the company's AR2023/AR2024, its dividend calendar page and the AGMS-2024 release still show 8 Dec 2023 - flagged in that record). The FS dividend notes' 'declaration date' column is not reliable (e.g. FY2025 final '21 May 2026' vs AGMS 4 Jun 2026; FY2024 final '17 Jun 2025' = recording date); AGMS dates are taken from the AGMS press releases / AR tables.
